Mail.//: GoDaddy shared hosting blocks external SMTP - see MailOptions. Its own relay needs no credentials and no SSL, and the From address must be on the hosted domain.

//WebPush: A chat notification when the browser is not on the page (or not even open) — VAPID key pair, generated once with WebPush.VapidHelper.GenerateVapidKeys() and never rotated after, since rotating invalidates every subscription already stored. PublicKey is not a secret (every subscribing browser is handed it); PrivateKey is, same footing as Jwt.Key above, real value only in the untracked appsettings.Production.json.
//Firebase: The installed Android app's counterpart to WebPush above — a chat notification reaching the app even fully closed, via Firebase Cloud Messaging. ServiceAccountJsonPath points at a service-account key file downloaded from the Firebase console (Project Settings > Service Accounts > Generate new private key) — a credential, not a path to check in, same footing as Jwt.Key: real value only in the untracked appsettings.Production.json, and the file itself lives outside the repo entirely. Left empty, chat simply sends no FCM push — every other chat feature (REST, SignalR, Web Push to browsers) is unaffected.
//Ai: Powers the teacher competency exam portal's question and study-guide generation (see GeminiExamQuestionGenerator) — Google's Gemini API, which has a free tier (aistudio.google.com, no card needed). ApiKey is a credential, same footing as Jwt.Key: real value only in the untracked appsettings.Production.json. Left empty, scheduling a sitting fails with a clear message and nothing else in the app is affected. Model defaults to gemini-3.6-flash if left blank.
//Attendance: Enabled controls whether staff SEE the attendance pages. The endpoints are role-guarded regardless, so the feature can be tested on the live server before it is revealed. Set Enabled to true when it has been tested.
//Org: Enabled controls whether the staff hierarchy chart is SHOWN on profiles and the dashboard. The endpoints are role-guarded regardless, so the chart can be built and reviewed on the live server before it is revealed. Set Enabled to true once it has been checked.
//Competition: Enabled controls whether the Drawing & Dance competition banner and public registration portal are SHOWN. The endpoints are role-guarded regardless, so the portal can be built and dry-run on the live server before anyone sees it. Set Enabled to true once it has been tested.

InstituteProfile.Introduction: Avijan is an ISO 9001: 2015 certified institution is the brainchild of a group of professionals. We have started this computer center in the year 2008 keeping in mind to increase computer education soon within the common man's reach. Gradually Avijan started Multi-Functional Computer Training Courses. Our vision is to create a world class quality institute for training young minds for the IT related profession. This has to be done by keeping costs affordable and infrastructure both physical and academic most up-to-date and accessible.
Highlights: ISO 9001:2015 certified, teaching computer skills since 2008
Multi-functional computer training courses from beginner to specialisation
ISO certificate issued on successful completion of every course
Affordable fees with a transparent ledger and printable receipts
InstituteProfile.//OwnerDesk: The front page panel. Put the owner's name in 'Name' and it appears above the designation; leave it blank and only the designation shows. Clearing 'Photo' hides the whole section.

OwnerDesk.Name: Anindita Mukherjee
Message: Avijan began in 2008 with a simple conviction: that computer education should be within reach of every ordinary family, and that reaching it should not mean settling for less.

Everything we have built since has followed from that. Small batches, so no student is a face in a crowd. Teachers who stay long enough to know their students by name. An ISO 9001:2015 certified course structure, from a first lesson on the keyboard through to specialisation, with a certificate that stands up when it is put in front of an employer.

We measure ourselves by what our students do after they leave us. If you are considering a course, come and visit. Sit in a class, meet the faculty, ask us anything you wish. We would rather you choose us with your eyes open.
